exposure: transvaginal uterine suspension to uterosacral ligaments
cohort: 20 women who underwent transvaginal hysteropexy through bilateral high uterosacral ligaments
finding: Transvaginal uterosacral hysteropexy appears a feasible mesh-free technique for apical support.
mod_finding: Two women (40%) who had not fulfilled their childbearing desire obtained a pregnancy and both underwent elective caesarean section at term.
